corrected.one_liner: Salesforce B2C Commerce (Commerce Cloud) is a hosted enterprise e-commerce platform whose storefront, catalog, basket, order and promotion data is exposed through SCAPI and OCAPI.
corrected.auth_notes: Admin APIs use an Account Manager API client with OAuth2 client_credentials; the CLI docs (fetched) also list JWT (private_key_jwt) and PKCE browser sign-in for a public client, with implicit deprecated. SCAPI admin APIs need a secret or JWT; browser sign-in is not yet supported for them. Shopper APIs use SLAS clients. Separate API clients are needed for SCAPI and OCAPI (from search snippets of developer.salesforce.com, which returned 403 on fetch). OCAPI is described as deprecated.
corrected.access_notes: Unverified; developer.salesforce.com returned 403. Search snippets say on-demand sandboxes need purchased sandbox credits via an Account Executive, and a community answer says there is no free self-serve realm. An Account Manager API client needs a realm and admin roles. Access appears to need an existing B2C Commerce contract or realm.
corrected.blocker: No self-serve credentials found. Access appears to need a B2C Commerce realm and contract, and sandboxes need purchased credits through an Account Executive. This is unverified because developer.salesforce.com blocked fetches. The API is broad (nearly 600 SCAPI operations in the MCP code mode). The MCP server (@salesforce/b2c-dx-mcp) is developer-focused and is listed as Generally Available in the repo README.
